profile.headline: Google SWE
profile.summary: Full-time SWE at Google. Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science and Technology graduated from Tecnologico de Monterrey Campus GDL. Working in a Backend role, starting my path with ML and new skills. I am passionate about developing myself out of my career and learning new things.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, Estados Unidos · Hybrid
positions.description: Working as a SWE for the Atlantis App Crawl team. Developing and contributing to software, project designs, and discussion. Communicate and help clients. Part of prod and dev on-call rotations.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Java · Full-Stack Development · C++ · AngularJS

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Worked as a Java SWE intern at ODA in Oracle. Worked on infrastructure changes to generate VMs as required by experiments using a Java server. During the last months, I ran experiments and made data analysis reports.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Software Development · Linux · Java · ML

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Involved in the development of an administrator view for a web application, based on PHP and SQL. The web application is used to manage information and schedules for psychologists working in high schools, the view in which I work is able to manipulate the entire database being user friendly.

positions.title: Student at Cisco's Mexico-University Challenge
positions.description: Developing a web application base on React and NodeJS with a team, the objective was to manage tickets reports of issues in the life-cycle of a component in a supply-chain based on the history of problems of this component. Using the data of the tickets we added features like reports each month, and simulation to predict the future issues.

positions.title: Google CodeU Participant
positions.description: Collaborated with a four-person team and a Google Engineer for the development of a web app using Java, JSP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript over a 10-week program. We explored and use Google Cloud API specially in App Engine and Datastore. Also developing a better understanding of industry best practices such as giving and receiving code reviews at GitHub, also extending an existing codebase and adding new features.
